floor1-demo.summary: 54 photos: job site, exterior, pool/patio, portico and mostly-finished first-floor interiors. Per-entry 'captured' is EXIF DateTimeOriginal (camera local time); the set spans 2026-08-04 through 2026-09-14, and captured: null marks the 4 files with no EXIF date.
floor1-demo.registryNote: 22 of these photos are attached as kind:'photo' references on documents AS100, AS102, AS104, AS105, A100 and A200 in platform/documents/registry.json. The in-app document library renders item-level references only, so those sheet-level references are index data; the browsing surface for them is review.html#photos.
